Title: General availability: New regions for Azure Search

Body.Content: We’ve announced the general availability of 3 new regions for Azure Search—Brazil South, Australia East, and Japan West—bringing the global availability of Azure Search to a total of 11 regions. Azure Search is a search-as-a-service solution for web and mobile application development that helps make it simple to set up and manage your own search index. Many applications use search as the primary interaction pattern for their users—and those users expect a fast experience. Now, applications running in the new regions can offer experiences with even lower latency. For more information, visit the Azure Search page.
Body.Markdown:
We’ve announced the general availability of 3 new regions for Azure Search—Brazil South, Australia East, and Japan West—bringing the global availability of Azure Search to a total of 11 regions.

Azure Search is a search-as-a-service solution for web and mobile application development that helps make it simple to set up and manage your own search index. Many applications use search as the primary interaction pattern for their users—and those users expect a fast experience. Now, applications running in the new regions can offer experiences with even lower latency.

For more information, visit the Azure Search page.
